description: `cli org invitation --help` prints the nested group topic and exits 0 (not an unknown-command error).

stdout.text:
Usage: prose [GLOBAL OPTIONS] cli org invitation <COMMAND> [ARGUMENTS] [OPTIONS]

Commands:
  accept                      Accept an invitation.
  revoke                      Revoke a pending invitation.

Examples:
  prose cli org invitation accept --token-file invite.token --yes
  prose cli org invitation revoke acme-research 7e6d5c4b-3a29-4817-8f6e-5d4c3b2a1908 --yes

Global options:
  --output human|json|jsonl   Output mode; the same as the PROSE_OUTPUT setting.

Run `prose cli org invitation <COMMAND> --help` for details. `prose cli service operations --json` prints every command as JSON.
